findings.reason: The cited evidence shows a LINK_LOS alarm on LNK-SUD-01-A and subsequent SITE_DOWN alarms on the sites, supporting the inference of a transport failure causing the outage.
T1 and ALR-0014 explicitly state that traffic, active users, and availability dropped on S-SUD-003 and S-SUD-001 between 15:15 and 20:00.
T3 and ALM-000233 confirm a critical LINK_LOS alarm on LNK-SUD-01-A raised at 15:27.
T3, ALM-000234, and ALM-000235 confirm critical SITE_DOWN alarms on S-SUD-003 and S-SUD-001 starting at 15:28.
T4 explicitly reports no changes on the specified nodes and their ancestors during the window.
T5 explicitly reports no maintenance windows scheduled on the specified nodes and their ancestors during the window.
